name: β-methyl-DOM
summary: β-Methyl-DOM, or β-Me-DOM, also known as 4-methyl-2,5-dimethoxy-β-methylamphetamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families related to DOM. It has two notable enantiomers, Daphne (threo-β-Me-DOM) and Elvira (erythro-β-Me-DOM).

pharmacology.text: β-Methyl-DOM has been reported to have virtually no hallucinogen-like activity in animals, but did produce hyperthermia at high doses.

uses.en: It is a research chemical with no medical use, studied to learn how structure affects psychedelic activity.
uses.zh: 它是研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，用於了解結構如何影響迷幻活性。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究化学品，没有医疗用途，用于了解结构如何影响迷幻活性。

sideEffects.en: Almost nothing is known about it in people. In animals it caused a rise in body temperature at high amounts. Related DOx compounds can cause anxiety, confusion and a raised heart rate and blood pressure.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響幾乎一無所知。在動物身上，大量使用時會造成體溫升高。相關的 DOx 類化合物可能造成焦慮、混亂以及心跳與血壓上升。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响几乎一无所知。在动物身上，大量使用时会造成体温升高。相关的 DOx 类化合物可能造成焦虑、混乱以及心跳与血压上升。

fact.en: Its two mirror image forms were given the names Daphne and Elvira by the chemists who studied them. In animals it showed almost no hallucinogen-like activity despite its close kinship to DOM.
fact.zh: 研究它的化學家把它的兩種鏡像形式分別命名為 Daphne 與 Elvira。儘管它與 DOM 關係極近，在動物身上卻幾乎沒有表現出類似幻覺劑的活性。
fact.zhHans: 研究它的化学家把它的两种镜像形式分别命名为 Daphne 与 Elvira。尽管它与 DOM 关系极近，在动物身上却几乎没有表现出类似幻觉剂的活性。
